inputs.basis: catch-up = fetches of the active parts r1 holds (covering parts replace the inserted ones merged away); per fetched part the replication-fetch.insert graph

source_refs.claim: a replica skips an entry whose part or a covering part it already has
without zero-copy or a relink offer the sender streams the part files
the sender sends every checksummed file
each sent file is read through the disk: one GetObject per object on the sender
the receiver writes each received file: one PutObject per file
the receiver loads the fetched part from its disk
loading reads columns, checksums, index granularity, primary index and row count
a fetch writes a DownloadPart row to system.part_log
a queued entry whose part is gone is served by a replica having a covering part
